  3. Website maintenance

Website maintenance with a clear scope, not vague promises

Websites need regular care to stay secure, fast, and accurate. We look after the routine work so your site keeps doing its job.

Ask about maintenanceRequest a site review

What maintenance covers

Updates

Framework, plugin, and dependency updates applied and checked.

Backups

Regular backups of site files and content, with a tested restore process.

Monitoring

Uptime and broken-link checks so problems are spotted early.

Content changes

Text edits, new images, team updates, events, and new pages.

Bug fixes

Things that stop working on a browser or device, investigated and fixed.

Performance checks

Periodic speed reviews, image optimization, and cleanup.

Security maintenance

Security patches, form spam protection, and certificate checks.

Support arrangement

A known way to send requests and a stated response window.

Defined limits, stated up front

We do not offer unlimited support. Every maintenance arrangement spells out what you get, so there are no surprises on either side.

Each arrangement states in writing

  • Which tasks are included, and how often they happen
  • How much change work is included each month
  • How to send requests and the expected response window
  • How work beyond the included amount is quoted and approved
  • Notice period to change or end the arrangement

Usually quoted separately

  • New features, new sections, or a redesign
  • Hosting, domain, and third-party subscription fees
  • Writing large amounts of new content

Plan names, included hours, and prices are being finalized: Website maintenance plan tiers, included hours, and pricing (placeholder, not yet confirmed)

How a maintenance request works

  1. Send the request

    Describe the change or problem, with a link and screenshot if you have one.

  2. We confirm scope

    We confirm it is covered, or send a quote first if it is not.

  3. We make the change

    Changes are tested before they go live on your site.

  4. You review

    We let you know it is done and what changed.

Did someone else build your website?

We can still help. We start with a review of how the site is built and hosted, then tell you whether maintaining it, improving it, or rebuilding it makes the most sense.

Want someone to look after your website?

Send us your website address and we will review it and suggest a maintenance arrangement that fits.
